data.content: In Q1 2025, all 74 commits targeted MRNIU/cpu_io, reflecting an intense focus on low-level CPU bring‑up with a largely **feat**‑tagged stream. The technical direction centered on adding AArch64 system register accessors (e.g., VBAR_EL1, ELR_EL1, MAIR_EL1, timer controls) and GIC interrupt controller handling, along with early riscv64 virtual memory support. Development was entirely solo, with zero pull requests, reviews, or issues, following a direct‑commit workflow with no collaboration overhead. Compared to Q3 2024, activity pivoted sharply from a mixed workload spanning 4 repositories (led by MRNIU/nzh_factorio_mod) to a single, deeply specialized project, and commit volume more than tripled. The bulk of the work was concentrated in January (71 commits), while February saw only 3 minor updates, suggesting a burst of rapid implementation followed by a quiet maintenance period.
highlights: 74 commits, 0 PRs, 0 reviews, 0 issues, 0 comments, 1 active repos
risks: High commit count with no PR activity
